versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Infinimo AI Design video generation skill.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and frame-to-frame creation modes.
- Provides workflows for model selection, asset upload, credit estimation, job submission, and result polling.
- Includes endpoints for asset management and detailed API usage instructions.
- Offers flexible input options: prompt-only, first/last frames, and multi-asset uploads.
